# Miroooo

Miroooo is a UK-focused electric toothbrush brand offering two models: Brush X and Brush X2. The store uses UK English and prices products in GBP.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://trymiroooo.com/): Brand and product overview.
- [Shop](https://trymiroooo.com/shop): Model comparison and buying routes.
- [Brush X](https://trymiroooo.com/products/miroooo-x): Lightweight model with three modes and 60+ days of battery life.
- [Brush X2](https://trymiroooo.com/products/miroooo-x2): Guided model with pressure feedback, IPX7 water resistance and up to 90 days of battery life.
- [FAQs](https://trymiroooo.com/faq): Product, care, delivery and return answers.
- [Delivery and returns](https://trymiroooo.com/delivery-returns): UK fulfilment estimates and the risk-free home trial.
- [Warranty](https://trymiroooo.com/warranty): Two-year limited warranty terms.

## Important context

- Product information supports general oral-care routines and does not replace advice from a dentist or hygienist.
- Delivery dates and battery durations are estimates that vary with circumstances and use.
- The final price, bundle contents and availability shown at checkout control an order.
